data.summary: The extraction is broadly aligned with the PDS for many core limits and plan variants, but several actionable issues remain around plan-specific add-on availability, cancellation limit basis, non-medical/pre-existing-condition treatment, and the Inbound medical limit field.

findings.reason: The extraction states Essentials cancellation cover is per person, but the PDS specifically identifies per-person cancellation basis for the Cancellation Only Plan; the extracted per-person qualifier for Essentials is not supported by the cited wording.
findings.source_quote: on a per person basis on the Cancellation Only Plan.

findings.reason: The notes repeat that Essentials cancellation cover applies per person. The PDS wording only states per-person basis for the Cancellation Only Plan, so this basis appears misattributed to Essentials.
findings.source_quote: on a per person basis on the Cancellation Only Plan.
findings.extracted_value: Essentials cancellation 'Cover chosen' applies per person. Other limits per adult unless stated.

findings.reason: The Medical Only product lists Electronic Gadgets as an available add-on, but the PDS says Electronic Gadgets is available on Comprehensive, Essentials, Inbound and Domestic, not Medical Only.
findings.source_quote: Available on Comprehensive, Essentials, Inbound and Domestic

extracted_value.name: Cruise Cover
extracted_value.availability: Must be added for multi‑night ocean/sea cruises

findings.reason: Cancellation Only is marked as requiring medical assessment, but the add-ons table shows Existing Medical Conditions is not available for Cancellation Only. This makes the extracted medical assessment requirement for obtaining pre-existing-condition cover on this plan unsupported.
findings.source_quote: Existing Medical Conditions | V | V | レ | x | x

findings.reason: The Cancellation Only product lists Existing Medical Conditions cover as an optional add-on, but the PDS add-ons table shows it is not available for Cancellation Only.
findings.source_quote: Existing Medical Conditions | V | V | レ | x | x

findings.reason: The Non-Medical plan is marked as having some automatically included pre-existing medical condition cover, but the PDS says this plan has no cover for medical, additional or cancellation expenses related to the traveller's health. The extracted status is therefore misleading for this plan.
findings.source_quote: no cover for medical, additional or cancellation expenses related to your health.

findings.reason: For the Inbound plan, the extracted emergency medical limit only captures the $10,000,000 overseas/outside-Australia Benefit 1 limit and omits the separate Inbound medical expenses in Australia limit, which is central to the Inbound plan.
The Inbound product's optional add-ons omit Increase Luggage Item Limits, even though the PDS states this option is available on Inbound.
findings.source_quote: Available on Comprehensive, Inbound and Domestic

extracted_value.name: Cruise Cover
extracted_value.availability: Must be added for multi‑night ocean/sea cruises
